# HealthLife Metrics

> Research and analytics for healthcare decisions.

HealthLife Metrics provides healthcare market intelligence, patient research, HCP and healthcare staff research, UX research, and data analytics.

## Services

- Market Intelligence: market assessment, market sizing, industry trends, stakeholder landscapes, competitor and product analysis, positioning, market movements, and opportunity prioritization.
- Patient & Caregiver Research: research with patients, caregivers, family members, and care partners. Focus areas include needs, barriers, behaviors, patient journeys, profiling, segmentation, personas, concept testing, and message testing.
- HCP & Healthcare Staff Research: research with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, allied HCPs, clinical teams, administrative staff, practice managers, and healthcare decision-makers. Focus areas include workflows, referral and treatment decisions, adoption, barriers, stakeholder segmentation, concept testing, and message testing.
- UX Research: healthcare website, app, platform, patient portal, professional tool, prototype, usability, information architecture, content clarity, accessibility, and benchmarking research.
- Data Analytics: healthcare, market, research, survey, journey, behavioral, utilization, and product data analysis; statistical modeling, forecasting, visualization, KPIs, and dashboards.
